messages:
sofia: FYI I noticed an odd spike in duplicate labeler hits during the qx3b-int4-v2 onboarding run. Several labelers got the same prompt twice in their queue. Looks like dedupe index mismatch after tokenmap v2 rollout.

andre: Ugh. Is this at ingest time or later in the sampler? We switched from sha256(content) to tokenhash(content, tokenizer=v2) last week. Might be a hashing collision / normalization mismatch.

sofia: Repro steps: ingest 5k prompts through staging sampler -> dedupe shard enabled -> run labeler batch. 32 of the tasks were dupes. I attached the small csv of ids.

mohit: Can you paste the CSV snippet? I want to check token counts and whether longctx truncation is involved.

sofia: CSV snippet pasted inline:
```
prompt_id,tokenhash,orig_len
p-1001,0x7c9aab,120
p-1002,0x7c9aab,119
p-2048,0xdeadbe,45
```
Not exact collisions on length but same tokenhash for p-1001 and p-1002. Both are paraphrases. Tokenizer differences could be normalizing punctuation differently.

andre: That suggests tokenhashing is the culprit. Tokenmap v2 normalized some unicode and collapsed repeated whitespace. If two near-duplicates normalize to same token sequence then dedupe is expected. But labeler duplicate problems mean the dedupe deduped wrong group key (should dedupe semantically similar, but we're getting near-exact duplicates flagged twice).

ella: Operational impact: labeler throughput wasted, possibly golden coverage skewed if duplicates land in goldlets. Let's prevent dupes from hitting gold. Temporary mitigation: labeler queue filter to drop prompt_ids with similar tokenhash collisions within the same batch (window=1000). Andre, can you patch sampler?

andre: I'll flip a config: sampler.dedupe_key = tokenhash_v2 -> tokenhash_v2_strict for 24h. Strict includes original content fingerprint fallback so paraphrases won't collapse. Will push a small config change to staging now.

labeler-bot: Queue updated: "onboard-qx3b-v2" - dedupe-strict enabled. Notifying @team-curation.

mohit: Also important for onboarding evals: our regression harness uses a holdout set of 2k prompts for quality / latency. We should add a micro-golden "quant-onboard/dup-sample-gold" with 8 cases: exact duplicate, paraphrase, partial overlap, long truncation, unicode variants. Acceptance: dedupe=false (i.e., unique tasks) and model outputs should be >= baseline quality threshold.

sofia: I'll assemble 8 variants and upload them to the goldlet. Tagging labelers @team-curation and setting P1 since this affects onboarding metrics.

andre: For traceability I'll add a dedupe-compatibility flag to each ingested record: tokenmap_version and raw-hash, so we can retroactively rebuild dedupe groups. Will store as metadata in sampling log.

mohit: Good. For the eval run I'll compare qx3b-int4-v2 vs qx3b-int4-v1 and track "duplicate-task-rate" and "labeler-efficiency". Also compare quality delta on golden. Plan: run 10k sample per variant, post CSV + small plot in 6h.

ella: Please also note in the onboarding ticket that if dedupe-strict causes under-deduping we may need to tune similarity threshold. Keep me posted. If customers see bad duplicates in their dataset ingest, escalate to #support.

sofia: Uploaded goldlet: quant-onboard/dup-sample-gold (8 items) + acceptance criteria doc. Labeler-bot, create queue please.

labeler-bot: New micro-golden queue: "quant-onboard-dup-sample" (8 tasks). Priority: P1. Expected throughput 120 tasks/hour.

andre: Config change pushed to staging (sampler.dedupe_key=strict). Rolling cat logs for 1h to confirm no regressions.

mohit: On my side starting the 3-way comparison run now. Will use buckets: short/mid/long and include tokenmap_version in the output. Posting results here when done.

ella: Thanks all. Let's reconvene after mohit's results. If anything unexpected pops up, raise a quick PR or revert tokenmap v2.
